title: Two Sum
prompt: Return the indices of two values that add up to the target.
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find the two distinct positions whose values add up to the target. Return the positions in any order.
examples:
Input: nums = [2, 7, 11, 15], target = 9
Output: [0, 1]

Input: nums = [3, 2, 4], target = 6
Output: [1, 2]
constraints:
2 <= nums.length <= 10,000
-1,000,000,000 <= nums[i] <= 1,000,000,000
Exactly one valid answer exists.
tests:
assert solve([2, 7, 11, 15], 9) == [0, 1]
assert solve([3, 2, 4], 6) == [1, 2]
print('All tests passed.')

title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Determine whether every opening bracket is closed in the correct order.
description: Given a string containing only parentheses, brackets, and braces, determine whether the input is valid. Every opening bracket must close with the same type in the correct order.
examples:
Input: s = "()[]{}"
Output: true

Input: s = "(]"
Output: false
constraints:
1 <= s.length <= 10,000
s consists only of (), [], and {}.
tests:
assert solve('()[]{}') is True
assert solve('(]') is False
assert solve('{[]}') is True
print('All tests passed.')
